# Real-world differential corpus for Daddybound.
#
# Format: category<TAB>qtype<TAB>name
#
# The list is deliberately NOT curated by expected verdict. Nothing here
# records what any validator is supposed to say — the verdicts come from
# libunbound and delv at run time, and a name that turns out to be bogus,
# insecure or unresolvable is as useful as one that validates. Choosing names
# because Daddybound handles them would make the whole exercise circular.
#
# Two sources, both stated so the file can be audited for that.
#
# 1. `tranco` entries are a deterministic stratified sample of the Tranco
#    top-1M list (https://tranco-list.eu/, top-1m.csv, retrieved
#    2026-09-08). Four rank bands are sampled at different intervals so the
#    corpus spans the very large operators, whose DNSSEC posture is
#    unrepresentative in both directions, and the long tail, where most of
#    the Internet's zones actually live. The sample is by rank arithmetic
#    alone; no name was inspected before inclusion, and none was removed
#    after.
#
#    A majority of these are unsigned. That is the point: an unsigned zone
#    under a signed TLD is the single most common shape in the DNS, it is
#    the one that must come out Insecure rather than Bogus, and a corpus of
#    only signed names would never test it.
#
# 2. `probe` entries are named for a specific DNSSEC shape the ranked sample
#    reaches only by luck: the signed root and TLD apexes, the well-known
#    deliberately-broken and deliberately-valid test zones, NXDOMAIN and
#    NODATA under both signed and unsigned parents, NSEC versus NSEC3
#    versus NSEC3 opt-out, and DS present versus absent. They are chosen for
#    the shape they exercise, never for the answer they give: the
#    deliberately-broken zones are here precisely because they must come out
#    Bogus, and a run in which they do not is a finding.
#
# Query types are spread across the sample rather than applied uniformly, so
# that positive answers, NODATA, delegations and key material are all
# exercised without multiplying the corpus by eight.

root-apex	DNSKEY	.
root-apex	SOA	.
root-apex	NS	.
tld-nsec3-optout	DNSKEY	com.
tld-nsec3-optout	SOA	com.
tld-nsec3-optout	DNSKEY	net.
tld-nsec3	DNSKEY	org.
tld-nsec3	SOA	org.
tld-nsec3	DNSKEY	se.
